Started off great, but quality is declining, misleading promotion. At first, this seemed to be the most accurate AI creator I’d seen. But over the last month, I’ve noticed a decline in the quality. The ai clips are becoming too cartoonish, they’re starting to do that weird thing where a person’s arms and other appendages are elongated and now it seems to completely ignore whatever prompt you put in. And when it does ignore your prompt, you can’t get those coins back.

The paid subscriptions are misleading. When you’re at the paid option screen, they advertise that you get “unlimited creations”, but then as soon as you pay, it changes to “discounts on coins”. So, you pay to have the “PRO” package, but you’re still only given a certain amount of coins. Once those coins are spent, if you still want to make more art, you have to pay for more coins or wait 24 hours to get more coins, and even then it’s not enough to make the art you want. So, in fact, it’s not “unlimited creations” because you’re still trapped outside another paywall to make more. It’s very misleading, falsely advertised, and I feel I was straight up lied to. To me, if you’re paying for “unlimited creations”, then there should be no more coins, just create as you will.
